            Tell me the restaurant name, rating, address, the price per person, and the operating hours.

```python
# Get all restaurants in Paris
all_restaurants = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get the names of all restaurants
restaurant_names = [restaurant["name"] for restaurant in all_restaurants]

# Get the cuisine type of all restaurants
cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurant_names)

# Filter restaurants that serve Chinese cuisine
chinese_restaurants = [name for name, cuisine in cuisine_types.items() if cuisine == "Chinese"]

# Get the operating hours of all Chinese restaurants
operating_hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours(chinese_restaurants)

# Filter restaurants that are open on Mondays
monday_restaurants = [name for name, hours in operating_hours.items() if "Monday" in hours]

# Get the price per person of all Chinese restaurants that are open on Mondays
prices = get_price_for_restaurants(monday_restaurants)

# Filter restaurants with prices under 34 euros per person
affordable_restaurants = [name for name, price in prices.items() if price < 34]

# Get the rating and reviews of all affordable restaurants
ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(affordable_restaurants)

# Get the address of all affordable restaurants
addresses = get_restaurants_address(affordable_restaurants)

# Find the restaurant with the best rating
best_restaurant = max(ratings, key=ratings.get)

# Print the details of the best restaurant
print("Restaurant Name:", best_restaurant)
print("Rating:", ratings[best_restaurant])
print("Address:", addresses[best_restaurant])
print("Price per person:", prices[best_restaurant])
print("Operating Hours:", operating_hours[best_restaurant])
```
